## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (format, lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage)
- [ ] `bun run build` and `bun run test:pack` pass, if the library's code or its package files changed
- [ ] `bun run --filter example test:e2e` passes, if the demo or the client behavior changed
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] Docs and the README are updated
- [ ] `packages/astro-eclipse/CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
